title: Rewards Program Terms for Personal Credit Cards: Redemption Values, Minimums and Forfeiture
content:
A tier of Personal Credit Cards that earns rewards also fixes the smallest redemption it accepts, the ways points may be redeemed, what one point is worth in each of them, and the days past due at which all unredeemed points are forfeited.

| Tier | Smallest redemption | Ways points may be redeemed | Value of one point in cash | Value of one point in travel | Days past due at which points are forfeited |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | not applicable | none | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| College Rewards Visa | 2500 points | statement credit, deposit to a checking account, deposit to a savings account | 0.01 USD | not applicable | 60 |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | not applicable | none | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 2500 points | statement credit, deposit to a checking account, deposit to a savings account | 0.01 USD | not applicable | 60 |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 5000 points | statement credit, deposit to a checking account, deposit to a savings account, travel booking, gift card | 0.01 USD | 0.0125 USD | 60 |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 5000 points | statement credit, deposit to a checking account, deposit to a savings account, travel booking, gift card | 0.01 USD | 0.015 USD | 60 |

*Illustrative reading of the table.* On a hypothetical tier row taken from Travel Rewards Visa Signature, 8000 points are worth 80.00 USD as a statement credit, one point being worth 0.01 USD, and 100.00 USD against travel, one point being worth 0.0125 USD; the same 8000 points on Visa Infinite Private Client are worth 120.00 USD against travel at 0.015 USD a point.

The cash value of a point, 0.01 USD, is the same on all four earning tiers. Only the two points tiers offer travel booking and gift cards, and only they carry a travel value. The smallest redemption doubles from 2500 points on the two cash back tiers to 5000 points on the two points tiers, and forfeiture stands at 60 days past due wherever points can be held at all.
